W2 (empirical), after E022. Tip is E017: 6.548 s, 0.7537, about 0.07 pp above the 0.753 bar.

Measured chain: E004 compiled 0.7486/9.04. E005 +EMA 0.7583/9.10. E006 +Muon 0.7649/9.45. E007 prog-res 0.7590/7.33. E008 -0.5ep 0.7572/6.98. E010 width 512 0.7548/6.64. E011 aggressive res 0.7451/5.70. E015 CUDA graphs 0.7574/6.58. E016 wd/2 0.7607/6.58. E017 break-free 0.7537/6.548. E018 24/32 only 0.7502/5.99. E019 rerun of E016 code 0.7541/6.54. E020 -1 epoch 0.7528/5.86. E021 group 2 at 320: 0.7530/6.04. E022 SGD-group wd x0.25 0.7545/6.548.

Mechanisms:
1. Epoch dial: about 0.1-0.15 pp and about 5% of time per 0.5 epoch (E008, E020). Roughly linear. E020 lost only 0.1 pp for -1 epoch.
2. EMA/Lookahead gave +0.97 pp for +0.06 s (E005). Muon gave +0.66 pp for +0.35 s (E006).
3. Time tracks FLOPs and pixel count. Narrowing group 2 to 320 cut 7.8% of time for -0.08 to -0.3 pp. Width 576->512 cut 4.8% for -0.25 pp. Resolution cuts cost the most accuracy per unit of time (E011 -0.9 pp, E018 -0.7 pp).
4. wd, label smoothing, Muon lr and LR floor are flat within noise (E009, E013, E014, E022). E016's 0.7607 was noise, since E019 got 0.7541 on the same code. The true mean is about 0.754.
5. CUDA graphs and break removal gave about 1% each. The run is compute-bound.
6. Noise: a rerun of identical code is bit-identical, but a math-identical edit reshuffles the 3-seed mean by ±0.3-0.4 pp. Time noise is about 0.5%.

Misses: I under-predicted EMA, Muon and E016. I was too pessimistic on the time of E011, E020 and E021. I over-predicted E018. Lesson: time effects are predictable, but accuracy differences below 0.4 pp are unresolvable.

Unsure: whether the tip's true mean clears 0.75 on 40 seeds, and whether any free accuracy gain exists. Every further trim lands at about 0.752-0.754, so the 0.753 bar is a coin flip. Accuracy gains from schedule or regularization tweaks should be treated as zero ± 0.3.

forecasts.reason: A 20 px phase over 15% of steps saves about 3% of time and costs about 0.1-0.2 pp, which is within noise.
-0.5 epoch gives about -5% time and about -0.1 pp. The 3-seed mean is likely near or just below the 0.753 bar.
26 px saves about 4% of pixels overall and about 1.5% of time. The accuracy change is smaller than the noise.
Averaging tweaks are likely flat within noise. A gain of 0.1 pp or less is expected, and it is unresolvable with 3 seeds.
The label smoothing change was flat in E013, and per-phase variation is unlikely to add 0.2 pp.
A diagnostic with no recipe change. It likely shows some low-efficiency small-map convs, which explains the partial MAC-to-time return in E021.

cruxes: What is the true 40-seed mean of the tip? Held-out seeds 3-12 would show whether it clears 0.75 and how much trimming budget remains.
Is the epoch dial really about 0.1 pp per 0.5 epoch? If so, trimming epochs is the cheapest time lever.
Why did group 2 at 320 return only about half its MAC savings? The per-layer efficiency profile sets the payoff of architecture cuts.
